subject: Oceanography
title: Deep-Sea Life
description: Learn Deep-Sea Life in one minute.

hook.text: No sunlight, near-freezing cold, crushing pressure—and yet the deep sea teems with life.

buildup.text: Deep-sea animals survive on marine snow—dead organic matter drifting down from the surface.

discovery.text: Many deep-sea creatures produce bioluminescence—their own light in permanent darkness.

twist.text: The anglerfish dangles a glowing lure to attract prey—a living flashlight in the abyss.

climax.text: We've explored less than 5% of the deep ocean—most species down there are likely unknown.

punchline.text: In the darkest habitat on Earth, life invented light.
